relations: Black domino arcs linking colored arms to the center tip first, causing adjacent inner colored dominoes to lean.
The small red piece on the central yellow disc tilts down as its black ring dominoes fall.
Each colored arm collapses from inner end outward, flattening inner segments while outer tips stay upright.
Vertical and horizontal bottom black lines remain standing unchanged, and top-down floor framing holds steady.
caption: The video showcases a top-down view of a wooden floor laid out with a starburst of dominoes. Eight colored radial arms—yellow, green, light blue, navy, purple, pink, red and orange—each meet a central yellow disc crowned by a small red piece through a short arc of black dominoes, while a vertical black line drops from the center to a horizontal black line crossing the bottom edge. For the first portion of the excerpt the whole arrangement stands upright and still. Then the black connector dominoes ringing the center start to tip and the red piece on the disc tilts down. This disturbance spreads outward along each colored row, the inner ends falling first as the line of collapse travels toward the outer tips. The inner segments of all eight arms lie flat while their outer ends remain standing, leaving the radial collapse still underway. The vertical black line and the horizontal black line at the bottom stay upright and unchanged throughout, and the framing of the floor holds steady.
